title: Mandate 87: agents keep the board tidy
goal: Vision: V-12. CEO directive 2026-11-16: agents must keep the board tidy. Record CEO Mandate 87 in core (constitution entry, docs/ceo-mandate-87.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, README, self-build contract with no net line in core under Mandate 84) and guard it in the governance tests. The board and the board tidy command are in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (its T-AGENTCLAUDEBOARDTIDY-1).
limitations: Core carries the rule, its documents, the self-build clause and the governance tests; the board and the tidy command are the commercial tool's.
The self-build clause was added with no net line in core (Mandate 84): three phrases in item 12 were tightened without changing a rule.
